cause_quote: The introducing diff added `const completion = findInlineSlashCompletion(value, caret);` after the existing `if (argMatch)` branch, which always returned for drafts beginning with a command followed by arguments.
user_saw: With the cursor after `/statu` in `/name Draft /statu after`, the composer showed no `/status` suggestion and pressing Enter sent the entire draft.
summary: The fix gives the slash token at the cursor priority over leading-command arguments, so Enter or a click sends only the selected command and Tab only completes it.
reasoning: The original Lit diff introduced caret-based slash completion below a leading-command argument branch that returned before the new lookup could run. The Solid implementation already had the same ordering before the October extraction into the menu-state file, so the failure dates to the introduction of inline completion.
